answer: Grades are sealed when submitted and only opened at close, so graders cannot react to or copy each other, which prevents a Sybil cluster from coordinating its votes within a single jury. This design turns the attacker's greatest weapon — scale — into its weakest point, because scale is exactly what becomes unaffordable to maintain.. The effect holds because jury selection is secret and random, so an attacker can never target the specific identities that will judge it. Consider a inlet as the anchor of the cost.
